# Data dictionary

Every table and column of a MoukhlijMatExtract database (`LocalExtraction/local_output/`, `WebScraping/web_output/`). The same is written next to each database as `data_dictionary.csv` and as the `data_dictionary` sheet of `database.xlsx`.

No cell is left empty: a value the paper does not give is answered from the context, the composition or a convention, and the `basis` columns say which (`assumed (…)` for a default).

*Generated by `python -m LocalExtraction.schema` — edit `LocalExtraction/schema.py`, not this file.*

## `papers.csv`

One row per paper: its bibliographic record, where the file came from, and what read it.

| Column | Type / unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `paper_id` | text | The paper: its PDF file name (the key that joins every table). |
| `filename` | text | The PDF file name. |
| `title` | text | The article's title, as the paper (else OpenAlex) states it; the file name marked “no title found in the paper” otherwise. |
| `authors` | text | The authors, separated by “; ”. |
| `journal` | text | The journal or venue. |
| `doi` | text | The DOI, lower case. |
| `publication_year` | year | The year of publication. |
| `metadata_basis` | text | Where the bibliographic fields come from: the PDF, its text, OpenAlex, Crossref. |
| `n_materials` | integer | How many materials the paper names. |
| `n_relations` | integer | How many material ↔ value links were made. |
| `n_references` | integer | How many references the paper's reference list holds. |
| `origin` | text | “local” for a PDF of this computer, “web” for one fetched by Web scraping. |
| `source_service` | text | The service the PDF came from (arXiv, PubMed Central, Unpaywall, a publisher, “a file of this computer”). |
| `source_url` | URL | Where the PDF was fetched from (file:// for a local file). |
| `license` | text | The license of the copy, as the source states it (cc-by, cc-by-nc-nd, …). |
| `retrieved_at` | date-time | When the copy was fetched (or the file's date). |
| `file_sha256` | hex | SHA-256 of the PDF: the same file under two names is one paper. |
| `openalex_id` | text | The paper's OpenAlex id (W…), when found. |
| `extracted_with` | text | The software version and the spaCy language model that read the paper (and the git commit, from a source checkout). |

## `materials.csv`

Every material a paper names, with its composition, structure and ionic radii.

| Column | Type / unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `paper_id` | text | The paper: its PDF file name (the key that joins every table). |
| `title` | text | The article's title, as the paper (else OpenAlex) states it; the file name marked “no title found in the paper” otherwise. |
| `material_id` | text | The material within its paper (MAT_1, MAT_2, …). |
| `raw_formula` | text | The material as the paper writes it. |
| `normalized_formula` | text | One spelling per composition: elements from the least to the most electronegative (Li6PS5Cl, Li10GeP2S12). |
| `elements` | JSON | Element amounts of the material, e.g. {"Li": 6.0, "P": 1.0, "S": 5.0, "Cl": 1.0}. |
| `elements_basis` | text | How the composition is known (the formula, a known alias, a series member). |
| `structure` | text | Crystal system, structure family, polymorph, space group (cubic \| garnet \| Ia-3d); else the kind of compound (thiophosphate, oxide, …). |
| `structure_basis` | text | Where the structure comes from: stated, the context, known for this composition. |
| `ionic_radii` | JSON | Shannon ionic radius (Å) of each ion, from the composition (charge-balanced, six-fold coordination): {"Li+": 0.76, …}. |
| `ionic_radii_basis` | text | The oxidation states and coordination assumed for ionic_radii. |
| `is_known_alias` | boolean | The material was named by a known abbreviation (LLZO, LGPS, …). |
| `confidence` | 0–1 | A heuristic score of the extraction (the context of the sentence and of the material link). Not a calibrated probability: see mme-eval for its calibration. |
| `extracted_from` | Text | Table | Figure | The part of the paper the value was read from (a figure: its caption; plotted points are not read). |
| `page` | integer | The page of the PDF. |
| `section` | text | The section of the paper (Abstract, Results, Methods, …). |

## `properties.csv`

Every value of a material, of any property (the four transport quantities too), with its context.

| Column | Type / unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `paper_id` | text | The paper: its PDF file name (the key that joins every table). |
| `title` | text | The article's title, as the paper (else OpenAlex) states it; the file name marked “no title found in the paper” otherwise. |
| `material_id` | text | The material within its paper (MAT_1, MAT_2, …). |
| `material_formula` | text | The material the value belongs to, in its normalized spelling. |
| `composition` | JSON | Element amounts of the material, elements in alphabetical order. |
| `structure` | text | Crystal system, structure family, polymorph, space group (cubic \| garnet \| Ia-3d); else the kind of compound (thiophosphate, oxide, …). |
| `ionic_radii` | JSON | Shannon ionic radius (Å) of each ion, from the composition (charge-balanced, six-fold coordination): {"Li+": 0.76, …}. |
| `material_link` | text | How the value was tied to its material (apposition, proximity, table row, paragraph topic, …). |
| `category` | text | The kind of property: ELECTROCHEMICAL, STRUCTURAL, DFT, AIMD, ML, SYNTHESIS, … |
| `property_name` | text | The property: Activation_Energy, Ionic_Conductivity, Lattice_Parameter, … |
| `raw_value` | text | The value as the paper writes it (1.16 mS cm−1). |
| `normalized_value` | text | The value in the unit of its property (0.00116 S/cm). |
| `unit` | text | The unit of normalized_value. |
| `extracted_from` | Text | Table | Figure | The part of the paper the value was read from (a figure: its caption; plotted points are not read). |
| `page` | integer | The page of the PDF. |
| `temperature` | text | The temperature the value holds at: kelvin (298.1 K), room temperature, or the fitting range of an activation energy (300-700 K). |
| `pressure` | text | The pressure of the measurement (0.005 GPa) or ambient pressure. |
| `data_origin` | experimental | simulation | Measured, or computed (DFT, AIMD/MD, NEB, ML). |
| `attribution` | this work | cited | A result of the paper itself, or one it quotes from another source. |
| `n_assumed` | integer | How many of the context answers (structure, temperature, pressure, origin, component, ion) are defaults rather than read from the paper. |
| `basis` | text | Where each context answer comes from — stated, context, caption of Figure 3, table, paper, known, or assumed (and why): “structure: … \| temperature: … \| ion: …”. |
| `confidence` | 0–1 | A heuristic score of the extraction (the context of the sentence and of the material link). Not a calibrated probability: see mme-eval for its calibration. |
| `source` | text | Where it was read, in words: “Text, citing Figure 4b”, “Table 2, row: LLZO \| column: Ea (eV)”. |
| `section` | text | The section of the paper (Abstract, Results, Methods, …). |
| `sentence` | text | The verbatim sentence the value was read from (the caption, for a table cell). |

## `activation_energy.csv`

The activation energies (migration barriers, Ea, …), one numeric column in eV.

| Column | Type / unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `paper_id` | text | The paper: its PDF file name (the key that joins every table). |
| `title` | text | The article's title, as the paper (else OpenAlex) states it; the file name marked “no title found in the paper” otherwise. |
| `material_formula` | text | The material the value belongs to, in its normalized spelling. |
| `activation_energy_eV` | number, eV | The activation energy in eV, whatever the paper's unit. |
| `reported_as` | text | The paper's own word for the quantity (activation energy, Ea, migration barrier, …). |
| `extracted_from` | Text | Table | Figure | The part of the paper the value was read from (a figure: its caption; plotted points are not read). |
| `page` | integer | The page of the PDF. |
| `plausibility` | text | “in range”, or “check: …” for a value outside the range known for ion conductors or carried by another species than a conducting ion (left out of the ranking by default). |
| `composition` | JSON | Element amounts of the material, elements in alphabetical order. |
| `structure` | text | Crystal system, structure family, polymorph, space group (cubic \| garnet \| Ia-3d); else the kind of compound (thiophosphate, oxide, …). |

| `temperature` | text | The temperature the value holds at: kelvin (298.1 K), room temperature, or the fitting range of an activation energy (300-700 K). |
| `pressure` | text | The pressure of the measurement (0.005 GPa) or ambient pressure. |
| `data_origin` | experimental | simulation | Measured, or computed (DFT, AIMD/MD, NEB, ML). |
| `transport_component` | bulk | grain_boundary | surface | total | Which part of the sample the transport value is for. |
| `mobile_ion` | text | The species that moves: Li+, Na+, K+, Ag+, Cu+, Mg2+, Zn2+, Ca2+, Al3+, H+, O2-, F-, electron, or another element the sentence says moves (Co). |
| `attribution` | this work | cited | A result of the paper itself, or one it quotes from another source. |
| `n_assumed` | integer | How many of the context answers (structure, temperature, pressure, origin, component, ion) are defaults rather than read from the paper. |
| `basis` | text | Where each context answer comes from — stated, context, caption of Figure 3, table, paper, known, or assumed (and why): “structure: … \| temperature: … \| ion: …”. |
| `confidence` | 0–1 | A heuristic score of the extraction (the context of the sentence and of the material link). Not a calibrated probability: see mme-eval for its calibration. |
| `source` | text | Where it was read, in words: “Text, citing Figure 4b”, “Table 2, row: LLZO \| column: Ea (eV)”. |
| `section` | text | The section of the paper (Abstract, Results, Methods, …). |
| `sentence` | text | The verbatim sentence the value was read from (the caption, for a table cell). |
| `raw_value` | text | The value as the paper writes it (1.16 mS cm−1). |
| `material_id` | text | The material within its paper (MAT_1, MAT_2, …). |
| `material_link` | text | How the value was tied to its material (apposition, proximity, table row, paragraph topic, …). |

| `referenced_properties` | text | The properties the caption names. |
| `referenced_tables` | text | The tables the caption points to. |
| `referenced_equations` | text | The equations the caption points to. |
| `mentioned_methods` | text | The techniques the caption names (XRD, EIS, NMR, …). |

## `equations.csv`

The equations of the papers, or the standard form of a law a sentence names.

| Column | Type / unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `paper_id` | text | The paper: its PDF file name (the key that joins every table). |
| `title` | text | The article's title, as the paper (else OpenAlex) states it; the file name marked “no title found in the paper” otherwise. |
| `equation_type` | text | Arrhenius, Nernst-Einstein, MSD/Diffusion, Einstein Relation, NEB, Butler-Volmer, Fick's Law, Vegard's Law, Chemical reaction, Linear fit or Expression. |
| `equation_text` | text | The equation as the paper writes it — or the standard form of the law a sentence only names (equation_basis says which). |
| `equation_basis` | text | “written in the paper”, or “the standard form of the … law the sentence names”. |
| `page` | integer | The page of the PDF. |
| `section` | text | The section of the paper (Abstract, Results, Methods, …). |
| `variables` | text | The variables of the equation, separated by “ \| ”. |
| `variables_basis` | text | “its text”, or the usual variables of this kind of equation. |
| `context_sentence` | text | The sentence the equation stands in (or that names the law). |

## `workflow.csv`

The ordered steps of each study's experimental or computational workflow.

| Column | Type / unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `paper_id` | text | The paper: its PDF file name (the key that joins every table). |
| `title` | text | The article's title, as the paper (else OpenAlex) states it; the file name marked “no title found in the paper” otherwise. |
| `step_order` | integer | The step's place in the workflow. |
| `stage` | text | The workflow stage (Structure Retrieval, DFT Relaxation, AIMD, Arrhenius Fitting, …). |
| `evidence_sentence` | text | The sentence that shows the step. |
| `page` | integer | The page of the PDF. |
| `section` | text | The section of the paper (Abstract, Results, Methods, …). |

## `summary.csv`

One line per paper: its materials, how many values of each quantity, its highlights.

| Column | Type / unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `paper_id` | text | The paper: its PDF file name (the key that joins every table). |
| `title` | text | The article's title, as the paper (else OpenAlex) states it; the file name marked “no title found in the paper” otherwise. |
| `publication_year` | year | The year of publication. |
| `origin` | text | “local” for a PDF of this computer, “web” for one fetched by Web scraping. |
| `n_materials` | integer | How many materials the paper names. |
| `materials` | text | The paper's materials, separated by “ \| ”. |
| `n_activation_energy` | integer | How many activation energy values the paper gave. |
| `n_ionic_conductivity` | integer | How many ionic conductivity values the paper gave. |
| `n_electronic_conductivity` | integer | How many electronic conductivity values the paper gave. |
| `n_diffusion_coefficient` | integer | How many diffusion coefficient values the paper gave. |
| `n_other_properties` | integer | How many values of other properties the paper gave. |
| `highlights` | text | The lowest activation energy and the highest conductivities of the paper, with their materials. |
